text:
Clara (Frontend): Morning team — accepted the org SSO invite via Okta and can see the org, but when I try to open redwood-inference/webapp I get a 403 and `This repository is private or not found`. git clone also fails with 404. Who should I ping for repo access?
Ibrahim (Platform): @Clara can you paste the exact clone error and run `gh auth status`? Also did you authorize the org SSO prompt on GitHub (there's a link after you accept)?
Clara (Frontend): clone error:
```
Cloning into 'webapp'...
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: repository 'https://github.com/redwood-inference/webapp.git/' not found
```
`gh auth status` shows I'm logged in as clara.dev and `saml: authorized` for redwood-inference. I remember People Ops said we use SCIM from Okta.
Tess (People Ops): Yep — we provision accounts via SCIM groups in Okta. When you accepted SSO that links your GitHub account, but org team membership is created by SCIM sync. Sync is usually automatic every 10m but can lag. I'll check provisioning.
Aly (Security): Another gotcha is if your Okta profile hasn't been marked as "employee" or the new-hire group hasn't propagated. That blocks SCIM mapping.
Ibrahim (Platform): Clara, can you confirm your Okta username (email) and that you accepted the Okta app consent? If so I'll trigger a manual SCIM sync.
Clara (Frontend): Okta shows clara@redwood.ai and the redwood-newhires group present. I consented to the app.
Ibrahim (Platform): Triggering manual SCIM sync now: `idpctl provision --org redwood-inference --user clara@redwood.ai --sync-now`
idp-bot: starting SCIM provisioning job for clara@redwood.ai (job id: sc-9981)
Tess (People Ops): I'm watching Okta; group mapping looks correct. Sometimes GH side needs a nudge.
idp-bot: SCIM job sc-9981: success — user provisioned and added to team frontend-core (audit: sc-9981).
Ibrahim (Platform): Try the clone again, give it ~20s to settle. Also if you still hit 403 try `gh api /user/memberships/orgs/redwood-inference | jq .state` to confirm membership state.
Clara (Frontend): re-running clone... success! I can see the repo and pulled the branch. Thanks folks.
Aly (Security): Quick follow-up: we'll add a line to the onboarding checklist: "If SSO accepted but repo access missing, check SCIM provisioning and request manual sync via Platform." Also remind new hires to verify the Okta app consent.
Tess (People Ops): Will update the checklist. Thanks for reporting this, Clara — filing a small doc update so future hires can self-triage. :thumbsup:
Clara (Frontend): closing this thread — all good now. Happy to test the checklist changes when ready. :tada:
